state.target_sentence: Later on June 28, 2013, Party B, entered into a confidentiality and standstill agreement with Mac-Gray and was provided with an informational package for the purpose of providing Party B with data to formulate a preliminary indication of interest.

criteria.row_9: 06/24/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Target sale decision | Board forms a Special Committee of six independent directors, excluding CEO MacDonald and Moab's Rothenberg. The committee will weigh a sale against staying stand-alone and approach 50 parties.
criteria.row_10: 06/24/2013 to 06/28/2013 | Mac-Gray (BofA Merrill Lynch) | Round opened | BofA's outreach carries out the 06/24 decision; contacts reported by 06/28. NDA signers get an informational package, with preliminary IOIs due 07/23/2013 (no separate Deadline set row).
criteria.row_11: by 06/28/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Contact | Target-initiated. Pamplona is interested, including an acquisition by its portfolio company CSC (acquired May 2013), and says diligence would be minimal.
criteria.row_12: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013 | 13 other strategic parties | Contact | Target outreach. Of 50 contacted (15 strategic, 35 financial), Party A (#2) and CSC/Pamplona (#10) are recorded separately, leaving 13 strategic parties.
criteria.row_13: during the next several weeks after 06/24/2013 | 35 financial parties | Contact | Target outreach to all 35 financial parties (including private equity), among them Party B and Party C. 50 contacted in total.
criteria.row_14: over the two months after late June 2013 | 16 other financial NDA signers | NDA signed | 20 NDAs in total (2 strategic, 18 financial). Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C have their own rows, leaving 16 financial. Signing dates not given; each got an informational package.
criteria.row_15: 06/28/2013 | Party B | NDA signed | Confidentiality and standstill agreement; received the informational package.
criteria.row_16: 06/30/2013 | Party C | NDA signed | Confidentiality and standstill agreement; received the informational package.
criteria.row_17: 07/06/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Other material event | Refuses rollover partnership: denies the request (relayed by Rothenberg 07/03) for Moab to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona on a rollover. Such talks allowed only later.
criteria.row_18: 07/11/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | NDA signed | Agreement with Pamplona Capital Management LLC, reused in the merger agreement (s. 6.17). Received the informational package. Party A's NDA talks stalled on non-solicit terms 07/11-07/23.
criteria.row_20: 07/23/2013 | Mac-Gray | Deadline | Due date for preliminary IOIs. CSC/Pamplona bid on time; Party B and Party C bid on 07/24 and were considered on 07/25 (late bids accepted).
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
